saw_lines: Fashion buyers pick a piece for how it looks on them, then wait for the next drop before they buy again.
So the sale is won or lost in line one, before a stranger has a reason to buy from an unknown label.
Your site offers 10% off your first order, yet 0 of 21 ads mention it, so new buyers have no reason to act. Lead three new ads with it.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 27 Oct 2026
points: Your site offers 10% off your first order, yet 0 of 21 copy ads mention any offer, so new buyers have no reason to click. Put that offer in the first line of three new ads and on the creative.

Your site shows 48h UK delivery, yet 0 of 30 live ads mention shipping or delivery. Online buyers want to know when a piece arrives before they pay, so the question stalls the sale. Open new buyer ads with it.

None of your 21 copy ads shows a proof number, so a stranger has nothing concrete to trust. Pull one real figure, such as your review count or orders shipped, and lead the next batch with it on the creative.

Your 21 copy ads open with 10 different stories, and the biggest opener leads just 4 of them. Each new story splits the same buyers. Pick your two best openings and build the next batch from those two only.
